card.name: Inside Sanskrit and Pali terms
card.fires_on: Partway through transliterated Sanskrit, Pali or Buddhist names and titles, such as Vishwamitra, Vijñaptimātra and Yodhājīva. It fires on the middle or end piece of the romanized word.

modes.label: Buddhist text titles
modes.description: Middle pieces of Sanskrit or Pali treatise and sutta titles with diacritics.

modes.label: Hindu names and terms
modes.description: Middle pieces of Sanskrit personal names or ritual terms in Indian religious writing.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a long Sanskrit or Pali religious name or title.
